purity_grid_definition: 40 x 40 cells spanning the full range (min to max over all classes) of each axis; the `_percentile_clipped` keys use cells between the 0.5 and 99.5 percentiles instead. Noise-free: a noise-free upper bound on isolability.

classifier.seed_definition: each seed sets the measurement noise (independent SeedSequence streams for the optical pair and every bump product/precision) and the grouped fold assignment
classifier.paired_difference_definition: per-fold (bump set - no_bump) on the same folds; standard error = ddof 1 std over the 5 folds / sqrt(5)
classifier.across_seeds_definition: mean and ddof 1 std over the noise seeds of each seed's fold-mean metric or paired gain
